tool_args.rationale: Fit the three identifiable coefficients of the recalled subcritical mechanism numerically and use fresh confirmation to test generalization. Supercritical behavior remains unmeasured.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb-Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed strong sink-gradient response and monotone concave pilot are more directly explained by the recalled saturating sink-gradient mechanism.
All measured gradients are below the stated critical range, so its threshold and strength cannot be fitted from these observations; the required high-gradient probe is not offered.

considered_alternatives.option: Extra fine trajectory or open-branch probes
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both have already been acquired, and their observations support fitting the subcritical mechanism.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
